scientific_integrity: The infinite parameter and count ranges are handled by a recurrence and exact tail induction; symbolic Bernstein coefficients certify the finite polynomial comparisons. No finite experiment is represented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two runs and orders two through four. Subsequent modal transitions, higher orders and other run counts are not classified. Priority remains subject to independent bibliographic checks.
title: First non-order jump at the initial mode transition of the two-run negative binomial law
